#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on Python files in src/

    MYPY_EXIT_CODE=$?

    MYPY_EXIT_CODE=0

# Block the commit if mypy fails
if [ $MYPY_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then

    exit 1
fi

echo "✓ mypy type checking passed."
exit 0
